about: Impulse relay (teleruptor): each pulse from a push button toggles the contacts, so one lighting circuit can be switched from several places. 1NO (1 module) to 4NO or 2NO+2NC (2 modules). Add-on auxiliaries EPN050-053 add central control.
Silent electronic impulse relay in 1 module with quick-connect terminals. The EPS450B adds a switch-off timer, adjustable from 5 minutes to 1 hour.

Keeps a supply under its subscribed current by switching off non-priority loads such as a water heater or an AC unit. The 60060 is a 3-channel universal load shedder, 3 modules; the ED183 is a 1-module intensity relay.
Multifunction time relay with a universal 12-240V AC/DC supply and a range from 50ms to 100h, 1 module. One reference covers most timing jobs in a panel.
On-delay time relay with a universal 24-240V AC/DC supply, 1 module.
Off-delay time relay with a control input, 24-240V AC/DC, 1 module. Keeps a fan running on after the load stops, for example.
Drops the supply to emergency luminaires for a set 10-180 minute test, so the battery duration can be checked without switching off the lighting circuit.
Staircase time-lag switch, 30s to 10min, 1 module. Detects 3- or 4-wire push-button wiring automatically.
1-module DIN-rail twilight switch with a remote light cell, surface (EEN100) or flush (EEN101). Switches outdoor lighting at dusk. Spare cells: EEN002 and EEN003.
